scripts.text:
- Wait a second !! -
- You are carrying too many items -
- or too much weight to proceed. -
- Come back after -
- arranging your inventory. -
scripts.translation:
- 請稍等！！-
- 你攜帶的物品太多，或負重過高，無法繼續。-
- 請整理好物品欄再來。-

scripts.text:
[Mergician]
Do you believe in the miracle of Merge god?? If so, repeat my spell loudly as I pronounce it!!!
Merge Merge, Merrrrge!!!
scripts.translation:
[合併魔術師]
你相信合併之神的奇蹟嗎？相信的話，就跟著我大聲唸咒！！！
合併，合併，合——並！！！

scripts.text: What is the miracle of Merge?

[Mergician]
There is an order which rules the world and keeps the world to go well.
scripts.translation:
[合併魔術師]
世間自有一種秩序，維繫著世界的正常運轉。

scripts.text:
[Mergician]
But there has been a bad factor which totally jeopardised this rule!!
scripts.translation:
[合併魔術師]
可是，有個可惡的東西破壞了這份秩序！！

scripts.text:
[Mergician]
Those things which are separated even if they are composed by the same material!!
scripts.translation:
[合併魔術師]
就是那些明明材質相同，卻偏要分開堆放的東西！！

scripts.text:
[Mergician]
Have you never experienced this bad incident??
The fact that I had ^3131FFthe same potion, but appearing more than twice in your inventory!!^000000 So unpleasant!!!
scripts.translation:
[合併魔術師]
你就沒遇到過這種糟心事嗎？
^3131FF明明是同一種藥水，卻在物品欄裡佔了好幾格！！^000000真叫人受不了！！！

scripts.text:
[Mergician]
Believe in Mergism. That is the truth.
Then I can help you be happy and content.
scripts.translation:
[合併魔術師]
信奉合併教吧，這才是真理。
我會讓你幸福滿足。

scripts.text:
[Mergician]
This is the total holy ritual to pray to the Great God, Merge! and I am borrowing the power for a while!!
scripts.translation:
[合併魔術師]
這是向偉大的合併之神祈禱的神聖儀式！
我要暫借祂的力量！！

scripts.text:
[Mergician]
And if you eagerly want to be blessed by Merge, be humble and shout out loud! Merge Merge, Merrrrge!!!
scripts.translation:
[合併魔術師]
想得到合併之神的祝福，就心懷謙卑，大聲喊出來！
合併，合併，合——並！！！

scripts.text:
[Mergician]
Merge just heard your wish and let it be realised!
Open your inventory to check the miracle!
scripts.translation:
[合併魔術師]
合併之神聽到了你的心願，已經讓它實現了！
開啟物品欄，見證奇蹟吧！

scripts.text:
[Mergician]
You jerk!!! You just broke the whole rhythm! Why can't you get my flow and follow me?! Idiot!
scripts.translation:
[合併魔術師]
你這個混蛋！！！全讓你打亂節奏了！
就不能跟著我的調子一起喊嗎？！笨蛋！
